notes.title: Exiting Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32881904/b34c4dd7b86f42825f773301d7decf366013fb9a.png[/img]

During this time while we were in early access we did:

• Changed all sounds.
• The game has music.
• Changed the appearance of the game.
• Added FX effects.
• Fixed bugs in earlier versions of the game.
• New bonuses.
• Changed the appearance of achievements.
• Fixed the balance of the game.

[code]
Thanks to everyone who supported us while the game was in early access!

We also had a community: [url=vk.com/meokigame]ВКонтакте[/url]
[/code]
